title: The multiple-inclusion problem (slide 21)
tryThis: Read the error: the compiler lists the chain of `#include`s (`In file included from …`) that led to the second definition.
Fix it with `#ifndef`/`#define`/`#endif` in `A.hpp` only. It compiles. Should `B.hpp` and `C.hpp` get guards too? (Yes: something else may include them twice tomorrow.)
